questions.question: Akshar and Manvita recently celebrated their silver wedding anniversary and their older son Sanju’s birthday. If the age of Sanju 18 years after his parent’s marriage, and his age at their golden anniversary is in the ratio 5 ∶ 21, how many years after their marriage was Sanju born?
questions.solution:
Let the age of Sanju at their silver anniversary = x years

18 years of marriage = 7 years before silver anniversary.

Sanju's age 7 years before silver anniversary = x - 7

Sanju's age 25 years after silver anniversary (golden anniversary) = x + 25

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

156 - 13 + 9 × 18 ÷ 5 = 169
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6be2e65d1361e709c016e33ffe31eef24db0b28526070b8362fcaa857b9952b8.png] 

Given that:-

156 - 13 + 9 × 18 ÷ 5 = 169

From option 1:-

÷ and +

 
• After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get

156 - **13 ÷ 9** × 18 + 5 = 169, 

156 - **1.44**** × 18** + 5 = 169

156 - 26 + 5 = 169

**156 + 5** - 26 = 169(the positions of 26 and 5 are interchanged with their symbols)

**161 - 26** = 169

135 ≠ 169, it is not follow.

From option 2:-

× and ÷

 
• After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get

156 - 13 + **9 ÷ 18** × 5 = 169

156 - 13 + 0.5 **×**** 5** = 169

156 - 13 + 2.5 = 169

**156 + 2.5** - 13 = 169(the positions of 2.5 and 13 are interchanged with their symbols)

158.5 - 13 = 169

145.5 ≠ 169, it is not follow.

From option 3:-

× and -

 
• After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get

156 × 13 + 9 - **18 ÷ 5** = 169

**156 ×**** 13** + 9 - 3.6 = 169

**2028 + 9** - 3.6 = 169

**2037 - 3.6** = 169

2033.4 ≠ 169, it is not follow.

**From option 4:-**

**÷ and -**

 
• **After replacing the symbols with their meanings, we get**

**156 ÷ 13 + 9 × 18 - 5 = 169**

**12 + 9 × 18 - 5 = 169**

**12 + 162 - 5 = 169**

**174 - 5 = 169**

**169 = 169, it is follow.**

Hence, **"option 4" **is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements: **

All pencils are erasers.

Some sharpeners are pencils.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some sharpeners are erasers.

II. All pencils are sharpeners.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

questions.solution:
The Venn diagram is given below:-

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb0469ce24868f95a019e0a60a5250c60bb05f95289c0cb4459f1113a1a222cb.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some sharpeners are erasers. → Ture (All pencils are erasers, some sharpeners are pencils then we can say that some sharpeners are erasers is true.)

II. All pencils are sharpeners. → False (All pencils are erasers, and some sharpeners are pencils so we can say some pencils are sharpeners but all pencils are sharpeners it can be possible but not definite, hence, false)

Hence, **"option 1"** is the correct answer.

questions.question:
Pointing to a baby girl in a cradle, Sripad said, "She is the daughter of my father's mother's only daughter's elder daughter".

How is the baby girl's mother related to Sripad?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0fd6cab610f720d74911a910004a74b250f0cafb23fad64b63aa6509fbfac474.png] 

Sripad Said:- 

The family tree is given below:-She is the daughter of my father's mother's only daughter's elder daughter.

Here, My(Sripad) father's mother = Sripad's Paternal Grandmother.

Sripad's Paternal Grandmother's only daughter's = Sripad's paternal Aunt.

Sripad's paternal Aunt's elder daughter = Sripad's cousin sister daughter.

Sripad's cousin sister's daughter(Baby Girl) = Sripad's neice.

So, The mother of Baby Girl is Cousin of Sripad.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bf929fc26f09639973ebc33335aac8a5e92024854e4ad2fa4443c1949dc556c.png] 

In which Sripad's father's mother's only daughter is the only sister of Sripad's father and grandmother of the baby girl. So, the baby girl's mother is the cousin of Sripad.

Hence, **"option 2"** is the correct answer.

**Note:** There was an ambiguity in the original question paper in the previous year's paper. We have selected the correct options as per the given statement in question.
